reviews.review_title: Made me feel like a real captain
reviews.review_description: This game is so fun I didn't want to stop playing,  everything is really fun the story and the free Rome, talking to your Crew felt really good, and if you ever watched star trek your in for a big treat. I know I wished I could be on the starship Enterprise, and now I feel like I was for what felt like a short time I had a crew and meet an Alien race and sent my medical officer over to help their sick and wounded. The game is so fun, I just wish it didn't have to stop.  The crew are ai and have a limited time,  but I think I played for an hour an half,  but I'm not sure I was just having to much fun and it's true time does fly when your having fun.  Thanks so much  to the developer for letting me feel like I was on board a starship, and a captain. This is really fun, and a must try for everyone.
